context_requirements: Functional androgen receptor signaling and androgen-dependent gene expression
Expression of CYP17A1 and/or CYP11B1 for direct enzyme inhibition
Prostate lineage or AR-driven transcriptional program for any measurable downstream effect
falsifiers: No reproducible transcriptional change in VCAP at 6 h or 24 h
Clear AR-target gene changes in AR-negative lines such as A375, A549, HA1E, HCC515, HEPG2, HT29, MCF7, or PC3
Strong generic stress, proliferation, or apoptosis signatures across many lines

evidence.supports: Androgen biosynthesis inhibition is relevant to AR-driven prostate cancer models such as VCaP, but not to non-prostate lineages.
Androgen biosynthesis inhibitor degarelix modulates androgen-regulated gene expression in prostate cancer, supporting a prostate/AR-dependent context.
